table.title: [val2] 政务服务 · 办理时限
table.html:
事项名称办理时限（工作日）所需材料
法定承诺
企业设立登记151设立登记申请书、章程、法定代表人身份证明、住所使用证明
食品经营许可205申请书、营业执照复印件、与食品经营相适应的设备布局图
户口迁移103身份证、户口簿

understanding.purpose: Compare the statutory and promised processing times for each government service item, then see the materials required for that item.
understanding.reading: Readers scan row by row: first identify the service item, then compare the two adjacent time figures (法定 vs 承诺), then read the materials list. The two time columns need to read as a pair under their shared header; the materials column is a long reference list and will wrap.
groups: Columns 2 and 3 belong together: they are the paired 法定/承诺 values under the shared 办理时限（工作日） header and must stay adjacent for comparison.
Column 1 is the row-identification column and should remain visually separate from the time pair.
Column 4 is an independent reference list; it can be wider or narrower but should not disrupt the time comparison.
keep_intact: 事项名称 values ideally on one line so rows remain easy to scan
法定 and 承诺 leaf headers
办理时限（工作日） group header ideally on one line
material names and their 、 separators; break at separators rather than inside terms
may_wrap: 所需材料 lists, which are far wider than any feasible column
事项名称 in a materials-first design
办理时限（工作日） group header if the two time columns are compressed

preferred.name: r2A
preferred.note: Pull the time pair back to 54px each so the shared header span (108px, 87px of content) can no longer hold 6 glyphs and breaks at the word boundary into a balanced 办理时限 / （工作日）. 54px still shows 法定 (31px) with 2px to spare. The 34px freed goes to 所需材料 (258px → 237px content), keeping both long lists at 2 lines, so the table stays at ~252px while the header becomes legible.

preferred.name: r3A
preferred.note: Refines r2B: keep the merged time span at 110px, the largest that still breaks cleanly before （工作日）, while trimming 6px from the row-header slack (122→116, still ~95px text). The 1px gained per time column relieves the tight 法定/承诺 cells, and the remaining 4px goes to 所需材料 (249→253); row heights stay 60/36.

acceptable.name: r1A
acceptable.note: Pin col 1 at exactly 113 so 事项名称 stays one line (r0B's fatal flaw), give the two time columns only what their 31px leaf headers need (62 each), and hand the remaining 242 to materials (content 221). Every materials list then resolves to two lines, so all three data rows share one 60px height and the table reads as three equal units; the shared group header wraps to two lines, but that cost is paid once in the header rather than three times in the body.

acceptable.name: r2B
acceptable.note: Same clean two-line header break as pair-fix, but take 9px from the materials column and give it to the row-label column so 事项名称 values (92px) have ~9px of slack instead of sitting flush against the cell edge; materials content stays at 228px, still enough for 2-line wrapping in every row.

acceptable.name: r2C
acceptable.note: Explore the opposite trade: push the time pair to 82px each so the span (164px, 143px content) clears the ~139px needed for 办理时限（工作日） on one line, collapsing the group header row from 2 lines to 1. The cost is explicit — materials content drops to 181px and both long lists take 3 lines — but total height still falls to ~274px, beating r1C's 299px while giving the cleanest header.

bad.name: r3B
bad.note: New tradeoff: let 事项名称 wrap at natural 4+2 breaks to buy width for the time pair. 79+79=158 makes 办理时限（工作日） fit on one line, and 232 keeps materials at two lines, fixing r2C's 83px rows. Header height drops from 96px to 72px and data rows stay 60/36, so the table is about 228px tall; the cost is two-line row headers.
bad.why: Column 1 is starved at 89px, so the row identifiers themselves break (企业设立 / 登记, 食品经营 / 许可) — the one thing a row-header column must never do; the reader loses the row anchor and the materials column still ends up at 3 lines, so nothing is gained.

bad.name: r1B
bad.note: Same fix of col 1, but buy a little more air for the paired time columns (70/70, content 49) so the 法定/承诺 figures sit in calmer cells, funded from materials (226, content 205). Materials still hold two lines per row with the same uniform 60px rows and no one-character orphans; the group header still wraps, which is unavoidable — one-line group header (≥156 for the pair) plus two-line materials (≥226) plus col 1 (113) would need 495px.
bad.why: Gives 70px each to two columns that only ever hold one- or two-digit numbers, and pays for it by squeezing 所需材料 into three lines; the surplus also forces the group header into an ugly mid-word break 办理时限（工作 / 日）.

bad.name: r1C
bad.note: The header-first alternative: give the time pair 156 total so 办理时限（工作日） stays on one line and the 法定/承诺 pair is clearly framed, accepting a narrower materials column (210, content 189). This is the trade-off r0A was reaching for, corrected by fixing col 1 at 113; materials run to three lines in rows 1–2 but break at the 、 separators rather than leaving a one-character orphan, so it stays legible if header hierarchy matters more than compact rows.
bad.why: Same over-allocation taken further: 78px numeric columns for content 31px wide, materials down to 210px and three lines, table inflated to 299px, plus the same broken header split 办理时限（工作 / 日）.

rationale: The table is read row-first (which service, how long, what paperwork), so the first column must stay unbroken and the two 法定/承诺 columns only need to hold 1–2 digits; everything left over belongs to 所需材料, which is the only column with real prose. r2A and r3A do exactly that: 54–55px numeric columns (31px of content plus padding), 253–258px for materials, and the merged 办理时限（工作日） header splits cleanly as 办理时限 / （工作日） rather than cutting through 工作日. r1B/r1C and r3B break either the header phrase or the row labels while buying nothing, and r3B additionally starves column 1. r2C is the honest alternative: it buys the group header a single line at the cost of a third line in materials and 23px more table height.

general: Size numeric columns to their content plus padding, and give the surplus to the one column that carries prose; equal or 'balanced' widths are a false virtue when column roles differ.

A group header spanning several columns should break at a phrase boundary; the combined span needs enough width that its natural break lands there, which is a constraint on the sum of the child columns, not on either one alone.
The row-identifying column has a hard floor set by its longest label — if it wraps, every row becomes harder to scan, so never trade width away from it.
Fewer wrapped lines is not automatically better: one extra line in a prose column can be a fair price for a clean header hierarchy, and the reverse is also true.
specific: 所需材料 needs 414px of one-line text but has at most ~260px, so two lines in that column is unavoidable at this 480px width — the design question is only whether it becomes two or three.
法定/承诺 carry only 1–2 digits, so anything above ~60px per column is pure waste; 54–55px (33px content for a 31px value) is the efficient floor.
The merged 办理时限（工作日） header needs ≥124px combined across columns 2–3 to break as 办理时限 / （工作日）; at 124–140px combined it instead splits 工作日 or leaves 日） orphaned.

tradeoffs: Whether to accept a taller table (275px, three-line materials, r2C) to keep the merged header on one line, or hold the 252px height and let the header wrap into two clean lines — both are defensible; the 252px version scans faster row to row, the 275px version reads better as a hierarchy.
uncertain: Exact numeric column width past the content floor: some designers want visible air around 15 and 1 (62px), others consider 54px perfectly comfortable; also whether 113px on column 1 (zero slack over the 92px header) is acceptable or whether a few px of breathing room should always be reserved.

critique.good: Column 1 at 113px fits 事项名称 and all three row labels on one line, so rows scan cleanly. The time pair (80/80) keeps the shared 办理时限（工作日） header on one line and the two figures sit adjacent, which is the comparison the table exists for.
critique.problems: The materials column is starved: row 1 and row 2 both break to three lines and split terms mid-word (法定代 / 表人…, …设备布 / 局图), and row heights become 83/83/36, so the table stops reading as three equal row units.
critique.cause: col 4 = 206 gives only 185px of text, below the ~205–220px needed to hold each materials list in two lines; the 80+80 spent on the time pair is more than the 31px leaf headers actually require.

critique.good: Best row rhythm: materials fit in two lines (content 222px), giving a short 252px table with no dangling single-character lines, and the time pair still sits adjacent under its group header.
critique.problems: The identifying column collapses: 企业设立登记 and 食品经营许可 wrap to two lines and split mid-word (企业设立登 / 记), so the row labels — the thing a reader anchors on — become ragged and rows no longer read as units. The group header also wraps.
critique.cause: col 1 = 104 leaves 83px of text against a 92px one-line requirement (9px short of the 113px minimum); those 9px were handed to col 4, which did not need them.

critique.good: Column 1 is comfortable and the row labels never break; row 2's materials list resolves neatly into two lines.
critique.problems: The group header 办理时限（工作日） breaks into 办理时限（工 / 作日）, damaging the header hierarchy that frames the comparison. Row 1's materials spill to three lines and end in a one-character orphan 明 — the ugliest possible break — while row heights go 60/83/60, breaking the row rhythm.
critique.cause: The time pair (64+64−21 = 107px) is far below the ~135px the group header needs, and the 7px wasted in col 1 (120 vs the 113 minimum) plus the header wrap push col 4 to 231 (content 210), a width that is just short of a clean two-line break for row 1.

critique.good: The most compact of the three: every data row is 2 lines or fewer (60/60/36), the materials lists break cleanly at 、 boundaries, and the two time values sit close enough to compare at a glance. Header row is a tidy 2 lines.
critique.problems: The group header splits inside a term: "办理时限（工 / 作日）" — a 6-glyph line against a 3-glyph line, so the block looks ragged and the word 工作日 is torn. Also col 1 has exactly zero slack (92px text in 92px of content), so 企业设立登记 sits flush against the padding and the column reads cramped.
critique.cause: Times span 124px → 103px of content, which is just wide enough to swallow 6 glyphs (办理时限（工 ≈ 93px) but not 7, so the greedy breaker stops at 工. The break only becomes clean if the span content is under ~90px.

critique.good: Time columns are equal and the leaf headers 法定/承诺 stay on one line with room to spare; materials still break at separators.
critique.problems: It pays both costs and buys neither benefit: the group header still splits at 工, and the first materials row now runs to 3 lines (83px row vs 60px next to it), making the table 23px taller with an uneven rhythm.
critique.cause: Span 140px → 119px content, which is ~1–3px short of the ~140px one line needs, so it still breaks after 工; meanwhile col 4 at 226px → 205px content falls just under the ~232px that keeps 设立登记申请书… at 2 lines.

critique.good: Closest to a one-line group header, and the leaf headers and numbers have generous air; the time pair clearly reads as one unit.
critique.problems: Both materials rows are 3 lines, rows alternate 83/83/36, and the table grows to 299px — the reference column has been starved to feed two columns whose entire content is a two-digit number. The header still breaks badly anyway.
critique.cause: Span 156px → 135px content, still under the ~139px needed for 办理时限（工作日） on one line, while col 4 at 210px → 189px content is far below the 2-line threshold.

critique.good: Row headers fit exactly on one line; the 法定/承诺 leaf headers stay intact; 258px for 所需材料 keeps both long lists to two lines, so data rows stay at 60px.
critique.problems: The time pair is visually squeezed: each cell has only ~33px of text, barely more than the 31px 法定/承诺 labels. The merged 办理时限（工作日） header wraps to two lines, creating a 60px header band and making the central comparison look secondary to 所需材料.
critique.cause: 54+54=108px total leaves ~87px for the merged header, so it must wrap; each time column leaves 33px after 21px padding. 258px materials is already near the minimum for two-line lists, so width cannot be moved to the pair without taller rows.

critique.good: The 122px row-header column gives 事项名称 values ~101px, so they sit comfortably; the 54+54 time pair and 249px materials still produce the same two-line data rows as r2A.
critique.problems: The extra 9px in col1 does not solve the main issue: the time pair is still 54+54, so 办理时限（工作日） still wraps and the 法定/承诺 cells remain tight. The materials column is slightly narrower than necessary, while the row header has unused slack.
critique.cause: Same 108px merged time span as r2A; the 9px shift from materials to col1 changes only row-header breathing, not the header wrap or the tight 33px time cells.

critique.good: The 82+82 time pair is wide enough for 办理时限（工作日） to stay on one line, so the header is clean (0/5 wrapped) and the 法定/承诺 comparison has clear breathing room.
critique.problems: 所需材料 is starved: both long material lists wrap to three lines, data rows grow to 83px, and the row-header/time cells contain large empty vertical bands. The table becomes 275px tall and the densest content is the hardest to scan.
critique.cause: 82+82=164px leaves only 202px for materials (~181px text), below the ~210px text width needed for the 27-character list to fit in two lines; the one-line header is bought at the cost of three-line material rows.

review.method: two fresh-context blind reviews; letters shuffled; includes browser auto layout and equal widths as neutral references

r3B.why: Row headers wrap (企业设立/登记, 食品经营/许可) and the merged header breaks mid-word as 办理时限（工/日）, splitting 工作日 — the ugliest break of the set. Material column is reasonably wide (3 lines), so the table stays compact, but the header damage costs it.

r2B.why: Clean breaks: merged header wraps at the parenthesis (办理时限 / （工作日）), all row labels stay on one line, and 所需材料 gets the dominant share (~2 lines). Narrow 法定/承诺 columns are fine for two-digit numbers; rhythm reads well and rows scan as units.

r1A.why: Row headers stay intact and the material column is adequate, but the merged header breaks as 办理时限（工/作日）, cutting 工作日 in half even though there is room — a needless typographic fault. Otherwise close to B/E.

ref_auto.why: Column 1 is squeezed so hard that the header splits (事项名/称) and every row label breaks (企业设/立登记, 食品经/营许可, 户口迁/移), destroying the row-header scan path. The extra width given to 所需材料 does not compensate.

r2A.why: Essentially the same sound proportions as B: header wraps cleanly at 办理时限 / （工作日）, row labels are single-line, numbers sit in tight columns, and the material column carries the bulk of the width in two comfortable lines.

ref_equal.why: 所需材料 is starved to ~105px, shredding the long material lists into 5–6 ragged lines and tripling table height, while 法定/承诺 sit in wide, mostly empty columns. Proportions are inverted relative to content weight.

raw.unsure: B and E look nearly identical at this size; the winner between them depends on a few pixels of column-1 and column-4 width that I cannot measure reliably from the renders.

r2A.why: Balanced allocation: 事项名称 fits one line, 法定/承诺 are tight but adequate, and 所需材料 gets the dominant share so it wraps cleanly into two lines. The group header 办理时限（工作日） breaks at the natural boundary after 办理时限, keeping the merged group legible. Rows read as compact units.

r3B.why: Too much width given to the merged 办理时限 column, which breaks the header as 办理时限（工 / 日）—splitting 工作日 across lines—while 事项名称 is squeezed so 企业设立登记 wraps to two lines. The widest, most variable column (所需材料) is underfed, so row heights inflate unevenly.

ref_auto.why: 事项名称 collapses to 事项名 / 称 and every row label breaks mid-word (企业设 / 立登记). The materials column is reasonably wide, but the row-identifier column, which the reader scans first, is the worst offender—hierarchy is inverted.

ref_equal.why: Overly generous widths for 事项名称 and the two duration columns push 所需材料 down to four to five short lines, making rows very tall and the table hard to scan vertically. Good header fit, but the proportion is wrong for the content that actually varies in length.

r2B.why: Same logic as A with slightly more room for 所需材料: row headers stay on one line, the duration group header breaks cleanly after 办理时限, and material text wraps into two even lines. Clear column roles and steady rhythm.

r1A.why: Row headers and materials are fine, but the merged 办理时限 header breaks as 办理时限（工 / 作日）, cutting 工作日 in half, and 法定/承诺 are wider than their content needs while 所需材料 is slightly tight. Workable but the header break looks careless.

raw.unsure: Exact pixel widths are inferred from the render; A and E are near-equivalent in quality, and my preference between them rests on the slightly wider materials column in E versus marginally more breathing room in A's row-header column.

provenance.note: AI visual design judgement; not a human reading study
